create_bart_config: create a BART model configuration with default facebook/bart-large settings
configure_bart_encoder_decoder: configure BART encoder-decoder architecture with custom layers, attention heads, and hidden size
set_bart_token_ids: set BART pad, bos, eos, and decoder start token IDs for the model configuration
customize_bart_dropout: customize BART model dropout, attention dropout, and activation dropout rates
initialize_bart_with_config: initialize a BART model using a custom BartConfig instance
